blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–University of Santo Tomas scored a crucial 89-84 win on Sunday and eliminated Ateneo from Final Four contention while keeping its alive in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. The Growling Tigers strung together their third straight win and improved to 7-6, moving half a game of third-running Far Eastern University and La Salle, both at 7-5. Two more spots remain in the Final Four, with National University and University of the Philippines already safely through.
